name: DataGrip
summary: JetBrains says usage statistics are off by default in release builds, but automatic error reports are on by default. On a free non-commercial license, anonymous statistics are mandatory and detailed code-related and AI data collection is on by default. Data goes to JetBrains and is processed in the EU.

optOut.instructions: Open Settings > Appearance & Behavior > System Settings > Data Sharing. Clear the usage statistics, error report and detailed data collection options. On a non-commercial license the anonymous statistics option cannot be turned off.
